Block Matrix Deluxe Gold — 1.0 Release Candidate 1

Release Candidate 1: includes Gold Matrix missions, run records, persistent settings, large-screen and TV layouts, and repaired input and pause handling.

How to play: Move and rotate falling pieces to complete horizontal lines. Clear four lines together for a Matrix Clear. Fill four charge points to receive a Gold Piece; lines containing gold cells earn extra points.

Progress: Complete each level’s line target to advance. Optional mastery objectives award bonus points. After all ten levels, continue in endless play for a higher score.

Comfort: Choose UI Size in the Main Menu or Options. TV enlarges the interface for viewing from farther away. Losing window focus pauses play; return and choose Resume when ready.

Controls: keyboard and pointer controls remain available. Focused menu controls now respond normally, and held movement keys repeat without causing repeated rotations or drops.

DELUXE GOLD STUDIOS MANIFESTO

Our Promise to Every Player

The old computer rendered the pixels. Your imagination renders the game world.

Welcome Player

Whether you are entering a maze, beginning an adventure, solving a puzzle, surviving an arena, or chasing a high score, Deluxe Gold Studios welcomes you.

Every game begins with a simple belief: play should invite curiosity, reward skill, respect the player's time, and leave behind a memory worth keeping.

Why We Create

There is something timeless about handcrafted games. Hardware changes and graphics evolve, yet discovery, mastery, timing, strategy, risk, reward, and fair challenge remain just as meaningful.

Our goal is to continue that spirit through original games built around imagination, craftsmanship, clear rules, memorable play, and thoughtful player-focused design.

Our Philosophy

Curiosity matters. Great games encourage players to look closer, try again, explore alternatives, and discover what lies beyond the obvious route.

Mastery is earned. Accomplishment comes from understanding the game and improving through play.

Challenge should be fair. Success or failure should come from decisions, timing, strategy, and skill.

Every interaction should feel meaningful. Each movement, turn, placement, and button press should serve the experience.

Respect for the Classics

The games that inspired us remain timeless. They deserve to be preserved, enjoyed, and celebrated exactly as they were created.

Deluxe Gold Studios continues their spirit with new worlds and challenges while embracing thoughtful improvements in usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and player experience.

Our Promise

Every Deluxe Gold Studios game is handcrafted with care.Every challenge is meant to be fair.Every secret exists to be discovered.Every victory is meant to feel earned.Every player deserves a game worth remembering.
